paragraphs: Met Éireann is the Irish weather service. It has a yellow rain warning for Cork and Kerry. The warning starts at 10 o'clock on Saturday night. It ends at 8 o'clock on Sunday morning.
There is also a yellow warning for Waterford. It is from midnight to 12 o'clock on Sunday.
There will be heavy rain at times. Some roads may flood, and driving will be difficult. Strong winds will blow on the south coast.
Please take care. Do not drive or walk through flood water. Stay away from the coast in strong winds. Check the weather news before you travel. More heavy rain may come on Tuesday.
sentZh: Met Éireann是愛爾蘭的氣象局。
它對科克和凱瑞發布了黃色降雨警報。
警報從週六晚上10點開始。
到週日早上8點結束。
沃特福德也有黃色警報。
時間是週日午夜到中午12點。
有時會下大雨。
有些道路可能淹水，開車會很困難。
南部海岸會吹強風。
請多加小心。
不要開車或步行穿越積水。
強風時請遠離海岸。
出門前請查看天氣消息。
週二可能還會有更多大雨。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued a Status Yellow rain warning for counties Cork and Kerry. It is in place from 10 o'clock on Saturday night until 8 o'clock on Sunday morning.
A second yellow rain warning covers County Waterford from midnight until midday on Sunday. Rain will be heavy at times, and outdoor events there may be affected.

The weather service says there may be flooding in some places and travel could be difficult. Gusty easterly winds will be strong on south and southwest coasts, and there are gale warnings for the sea. On Sunday, rain will continue in the southern half of the country, with highs of 7 to 11 degrees. More heavy rain is expected on Tuesday.

People in the warning areas should drive slowly and leave extra space, and never drive or walk through flood water. They should stay away from the coast and rivers, and check Met Éireann and local news before travelling.
sentZh: Met Éireann已對科克郡和凱瑞郡發布黃色降雨警報。
警報從週六晚上10點生效，到週日早上8點為止。
第二個黃色降雨警報涵蓋沃特福德郡，時間從週日午夜到中午。
有時會有大雨，當地的戶外活動可能受到影響。
氣象局說部分地區可能淹水，交通可能不便。
陣陣東風在南部和西南部海岸會很強，海上也發布了大風警報。
週日，全國南半部會持續下雨，最高氣溫7到11度。
預計週二還會有更多大雨。
警報地區的民眾應該慢慢開車、保持更多車距，千萬不要開車或步行穿越積水。
他們應遠離海岸和河流，出門前查看Met Éireann和當地新聞。

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued a Status Yellow rain warning for Cork and Kerry, valid from 22:00 on Saturday until 08:00 on Sunday. A separate yellow warning for Waterford runs from midnight until noon on Sunday.
The forecaster says rain will be heavy at times, bringing difficult travelling conditions and possible localised flooding. Outdoor events in Waterford could also be disrupted.

Gusty easterly winds will be strong along south and southwest coasts, and marine gale warnings are in place off the Munster coast. Outbreaks of rain will continue across the southern half of the country on Sunday, with highs of 7 to 11 degrees. Further heavy rain, with a risk of localised flooding, is forecast for Tuesday.

Motorists in the affected areas are advised to slow down, allow extra braking distance and never drive through flood water. People should also avoid exposed coastal areas and check the latest updates from Met Éireann before setting out.

paragraphs: Met Éireann has put a Status Yellow rain warning in place for Cork and Kerry, in force from 22:00 on Saturday until 08:00 on Sunday. A separate yellow alert for Waterford takes effect at midnight and lasts until noon on Sunday.

The forecaster cautions that downpours will be heavy at times, making for treacherous driving conditions and raising the prospect of localised flooding. Outdoor fixtures in Waterford may also be disrupted.

Blustery easterly winds will be strong along southern and southwestern coasts, where marine gale warnings are in force. Rain will persist across the southern half of the country on Sunday, with temperatures peaking at 7 to 11 degrees, and a further spell of heavy rain, potentially bringing localised flooding, is on the cards for Tuesday.

Drivers in the affected counties are urged to reduce speed, leave ample braking distance and steer clear of flooded roads. The public is also advised to keep away from exposed coastlines and to monitor Met Éireann updates before embarking on journeys.

paragraphs: Met Éireann has issued a Status Yellow rain warning for counties Cork and Kerry, which will remain in effect from 22:00 on Saturday until 08:00 on Sunday. An additional yellow warning has been issued for Waterford, valid from midnight until midday on Sunday.

The forecaster says rain will be heavy at times, bringing difficult travelling conditions and possible localised flooding. Outdoor events in Waterford could also be disrupted.

Gusty easterly winds will be strong along south and southwest coasts, and marine gale warnings are in place off the Munster coast. Outbreaks of rain will continue across the southern half of the country on Sunday, with highs of 7 to 11 degrees. Further heavy rain, with a risk of localised flooding, is forecast for Tuesday.

Motorists in the affected areas are advised to slow down, allow extra braking distance and never drive through flood water. People should also avoid exposed coastal areas and check the latest updates from Met Éireann before setting out.
